headword: {工業革命|こうぎょうかくめい}

definitions.explanation: The historical transformation, beginning in 18th-century Britain, in which manufacturing shifted from hand production to machines, factories, and mechanized industry.

examples.japanese: {工業革命|こうぎょうかくめい}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{工業革命|こうぎょうかくめい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦イギリス→イギリス：28283_igirisu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain.

examples.japanese: {工業革命|こうぎょうかくめい}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧や⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The Industrial Revolution greatly changed how people lived and worked.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{工業|こうぎょう}→工業：01402_kougyou⟧ (industry, manufacturing) + ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧ (revolution). A standard term in history and social-studies education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{産業革命|さんぎょうかくめい}→産業革命：18638_sangyoukakumei⟧: the Industrial Revolution (the more common synonym)
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧{四次|よじ}⟦{産業革命|さんぎょうかくめい}→産業革命：18638_sangyoukakumei⟧: the Fourth Industrial Revolution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{産業革命|さんぎょうかくめい}→産業革命：18638_sangyoukakumei⟧: Industrial Revolution — the more widely used term in Japanese textbooks; {工業革命|こうぎょうかくめい} stresses the shift to factory manufacturing specifically
- ⟦{技術革新|ぎじゅつかくしん}→技術革新：12892_gijutsukakushin⟧: technological innovation — refers to advances in technology in general, not the specific historical event
